author: ojiudezue
title: Dead-channel build reviews: one Store per NM, validated restore; ship-ready pending attended deploy
summary: Tier-2 build reviews A and B both returned SHIP with one MEDIUM each. A-M1: a corrupt Store entry raised out of async_setup and would stop NM starting; restore now validates each entry and a failed load starts empty. B-M1: a fresh HA Store per save shares no write lock, so an older snapshot could land last and resurrect a closed episode after restart (a false HIGH alert); NM now holds one Store. Both fixed in 83b1e70a7 with drilled tests; the orchestrator re-drilled the one-Store fix red. Full suite on the fix-up: 23889 passed, 0 new failures. Review record v5.108.41_nm_dead_channel_alert.md.
why: HA's Store serializes writes per instance, not per key, so constructing one per call quietly removes the ordering guarantee. Accepted B-L2 (a dropped alert retries only on the next failure) because the persistent notification and anomaly row fire at episode open regardless. Deploy waits for an attended window because it restarts HA.
alternatives_considered: Debounce saves instead of sharing a Store (rejected: still two instances racing on restart flush)
